policy.implementation_complete: All I01-I08 verified against current executed receipts.
policy.full_family_complete: Implementation complete and E01-E02 verified; never inferred from stage counts.
policy.release_ready: Full family complete and R01-R02 verified for the exact candidate.
policy.scope_changes: Change the version and record the reason; reopen affected acceptance. Do not split new stages to substitute for an unmet point.

implementation.title: Named network interoperability and pairing
steps: Freeze receiver/source, polarity, pairing/unpaired-port, reference and source/export identity cases across all admitted contract bounds.
Execute one integrated import-transform-export replay with independent analytic answers and malformed/permutation/polarity cases.
acceptance: Existing SI08-S01 and source-bound network tests; current end-to-end campaign receipt required.

implementation.title: Causality, resampling and DC policy
steps: Retain explicit missing/supplied DC and interpolation policy; add analytical delayed/resonant causal and deliberately noncausal witness corpus.
Execute grid refinement and finite-band ambiguity cases; reports distinguish source causality unknown from a constructed causal realization.
acceptance: Independent analytical causal/noncausal fixtures; policy and witness regression receipt.

implementation.title: Operational known-standard calibration
steps: Integrate existing one-/multiport known-standard engines into strict public worker contracts with resource/cancellation admission.
Implement explicit general connected calibration-path graph within declared contract bounds, keeping unsupported crosstalk/acquisition states visible.
Exercise setup, saved input/coefficients/gauge/standards and capture replay, with independent ideal/nonideal references and invalid connectivity.
acceptance: Current SI08-S06/S07 are partial offline evidence; fresh worker/graph/capture evidence required.

implementation.title: Joint calibration and fixture uncertainty
steps: Compose unchanged calibration and coupled fixture removal using one explicit joint covariance, including calibration/fixture cross-correlations and coordinate maps.
Verify analytic chain sensitivities against an independent full wave oracle, correlation/cancellation witnesses, port/storage permutations and local nonlinear refinement.
acceptance: Source-bound coupled pipeline receipt with full-coordinate/covariance and failure checks.

implementation.title: Automatic passive causal broadband fitting
steps: Implement automatic stable real/complex-conjugate pole relocation with retained pre/post model and frequency scaling.
Assess broadband passivity between samples with a state-space bounded-real/Hamiltonian test; enforce only when a passive model is requested, retaining violation witnesses and failed models.
Freeze held-out delayed/resonant/multiport references, DC/high-frequency behavior, pole-order refinement, intersample violation and conditioning rejection.
acceptance: Independent transfer-function and passive/active state-space references; all requested error/passivity gates must pass without repairs hidden from provenance.

implementation.title: Loaded transient use of fitted models
steps: Map real and conjugate-pair fitted states into the existing loaded circuit application boundary with explicit reference/port order.
Execute analytical and independently solved circuit cases, step refinement, long-horizon stability and passive energy accounting; expose unsupported singular/initial-condition cases.
acceptance: Retained time/frequency/circuit comparison receipt with declared units and convergence tolerances.

implementation.title: Complete desktop and saved workflow
steps: Expose supported operations and unsupported states through existing discovery/setup flow, schema/worker/desktop save/run/export and cancellation.
Execute actual native supported narrow/wide, import/edit/invalidation/error/recovery/export replays and reopen source-bound captures.
acceptance: Actual worker/schema tests and trusted native observations with hashes; headless UI tests alone cannot close native acceptance.

implementation.title: Integrated implementation acceptance manifest
steps: Pin one versioned manifest mapping every original SI08 target and I01-I07 acceptance to concrete source, fixture, observables, tolerances and executed current receipts.
Run all integrated cases, reject missing/stale/failed/overclaimed evidence, and publish implementation_complete separately from full_family_complete and release_ready.
acceptance: Machine-checked manifest and replay of every implementation gate; no omitted scope gaps.

external_validation.title: Characterized standards and measurement corpus
steps: Inventory local approved measured datasets; accept only original measurements with instrument/state/grid/reference/standards/certificate/source rights and repeatability/drift/noise evidence.
If absent, request dataset paths and calibration-certificate/budget provenance from owner; define the exact missing records without substituting synthetic data.
Pin the accepted corpus and uncertainty budgets with reviewed traceability and declared coverage conventions before measured comparisons.
external_validation.blocker: Owner confirmed on 25 October 2026: no measured corpus yet.
unblock_inputs: Rights-approved VNA standards, fixture and DUT sweeps with explicit wave/reference/grid/instrument state
Calibration-standard definitions/certificates, repeatability/drift/noise records and joint covariance budget
Independent measured reference DUT and predeclared budget-derived comparison criteria

external_validation.title: Independent measured correlation and applicability
steps: Freeze observable-specific tolerances from the reviewed uncertainty budgets and an independent reference method before executing comparisons.
Compare calibrated fixture-corrected DUTs and fitted/transient predictions, document systematic residuals, standard-model applicability and nonlinear uncertainty adequacy.
Retain all failed cases and require review resolution within the frozen supported domain.

release.title: Knowledgeable human numerical review
steps: Provide governing references, independent derivations, source diffs and actual numerical/measurement evidence to the human reviewer.
Resolve recorded review findings and bind approval to the exact reviewed source; agent review is supplementary.

release.title: Exact installed candidate qualification
steps: Build a new candidate that actually includes all accepted SI08 sources, schemas and native components; preserve previous immutable installers.
Execute clean installed worker/desktop/native acceptance, cancellation/resources, upgrade/reopen tests and source/binary coherence checks.
Record authorized wayri identity and publication scope; no automatic publication from development-stage completion.
